_note: Steam games that run better on DXVK than on Soju's default DXMT. scripts/steam-profiles.py switches an installed one to DXVK when Steam starts, once, and never again after the player changes it (soju steam-games renderer ... reset/dxmt). Only Direct3D 11 games: the switch replaces d3d11/d3d10core/dxgi. Sources: Soju compatibility reports.
